page.overview:
What is Crisis on Cloud City?

The Crisis on Cloud City was an incident during the New Republic Era that saw the Nagai Garlev crash onto Cloud City on the planet Bespin, where he demanded to speak to his old comrades Landonis Balthazar Calrissian and Han Solo, former smugglers with major ties to the New Republic, Joined by the bounty hunter Beilert Valance, Solo arrived on Bespin and met with Calrissian, but, by that point, a mysterious assassin—secretly the Anzati Reyna Oskure—had already killed Garlev. The assassin then managed to escape aboard a new model of cloud car.

The Crisis on Cloud City appeared in Star Wars (2025) 3 and was identified on its cover. The storyline was first revealed via the issue announcement at Celebration Japan.
